command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; set -uo pipefail does not clear it (spawn#707).
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
echo "791d20817a3adfb67abdcca0e737b82b9612196b877e6681dcf0966889dd5152  gfs.py" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "FAIL: gfs.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
{ uname -m; nproc; lscpu 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Model name|Thread|Core|Socket|NUMA node\(s\)'; grep -m1 -E 'model name|CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; } > /tmp/out/host.txt 2>&1
python3 -u -c 'import ctypes,glob,sys; ls=sorted(glob.glob(sys.prefix+"/lib/libopenblas*.so*")); f=ctypes.CDLL(ls[0]).openblas_get_corename if ls else None; f and setattr(f,"restype",ctypes.c_char_p); print("openblas_corename", f().decode() if f else "no libopenblas")' >> /tmp/out/host.txt 2>&1
cat /tmp/out/host.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u gfs.py pin /tmp/gfs gfs-cycle.md5 /tmp/out/gfs-cycle.sha256 > /tmp/out/pin.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat /tmp/out/pin.log
echo "pin exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: staged bytes do not match the source"; exit 1; }
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u gfs.py run /tmp/gfs /tmp/out 32 all > /tmp/out/run.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "run exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
echo "memory.peak_gib $(awk '{printf "%.2f", $1/1073741824}' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak 2>/dev/null)" >> /tmp/out/host.txt
df -h /tmp | tail -1 >> /tmp/out/host.txt
cat /tmp/out/run.log
cat /tmp/out/host.txt
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'GFS THICKNESS REAL OK' /tmp/out/run.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
